messages.subject: problem with geom_area()
parts:
Hi everyone,

I'm having a problem with geom_area(). In certain cases, the y-axis
scaling or position looks larger than it should be.

Here is a code sample to demonstrate:
====cut====
require(ggplot2)
require(reshape2)

x<-seq(from=0,to=6,length.out=100)
df=data.frame(x=x,Uniform=dunif(x,min=2,max=4),Normal=dnorm(x,mean=3,sd=1),Exponential=dexp(x,rate=1/2),
Gamma=dgamma(x,shape=2,rate=1))
m<-melt(df,id=("x"))
g<-ggplot(m,aes(x=x,y=value,group=variable))+theme_bw()+geom_area(aes(x=x,y=pmin(df$Exponential,df$Uniform),
fill="red"))+geom_line()
g # shows wrongly-scaled area
g+facet_wrap(~variable) # shows correct area

====cut====
installed.packages()["ggplot2","Version"]
[1] "0.9.0"

R version 2.15.0

Any advice is appreciated.

Thanks,
Jason
